name: fireworks-kiss-hug-snapshot
image_purpose: Social event memory and authentic festival post

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical smartphone snapshot of two approved adults sharing a joyful romantic moment at a crowded fireworks festival.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman and approved adult man in a tight hug; he kisses her cheek while she laughs with a big smile. She wears a light summer dress such as blue gingham and he wears a light casual shirt.
prompt.composition_elements: Foreground couple large in frame, fireworks clearly visible above, crowd silhouettes and heads in the midground, slight handheld tilt, lively chaotic energy, portrait 9:16 composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Red and gold fireworks illuminate smoke clouds and faces, with subtle smartphone fill, deep night blacks, natural skin tones, intentional motion blur on faces and arms, and more defined fireworks.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone snapshot, 28mm lens look, f/1.8, high ISO noise, handheld motion blur, visible grain and slight compression artifacts, vertical 9:16.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 candid smartphone snapshot of an approved adult woman and an approved adult man sharing a tight hug in a crowded night festival; the man kisses her cheek while she laughs with a big smile. She wears a light summer dress such as blue gingham and he wears a light casual shirt. Crowd silhouettes and heads in the midground, red and gold fireworks filling the upper sky with smoke clouds, slight handheld tilt, intentional motion blur on faces and arms, fireworks more defined than the subjects, subtle phone flash/fill, high ISO grain, authentic imperfect romantic celebration.
